ai.summary: The page https://wck.org/ loaded in a headless browser with HTTP 200 and no load error. No installation code was found in the page source, and no widget request was recorded. The verdict is not installed. Google Tag Manager (GTM-MKV74FD), GA4 (G-5WKVY8503C), and the Meta Pixel (2145340818891888) were found. OneTrust is the cookie consent tool. No other donation tool was found. The page took 10.4 s to load its load event, above the 6 s check. One console error was recorded, a 451 status on a resource. The donate link https://donate.wck.org/campaign/749360/donate?c_src=site-navbar returned HTTP 403 to a plain HTTP client. The browser did not click any button, so checkout behavior was not tested. Only the links were found.

Review the page load time of https://wck.org/ and reduce the load event time below 6 s.
Check that https://donate.wck.org/campaign/749360/donate?c_src=site-navbar is reachable for visitors and does not block plain HTTP requests with HTTP 403.

customer_email.subject: Next steps to finish your donation page setup
customer_email.body:
Hello,

Thank you for working with us. We checked https://wck.org/ and found that the donation installation code is not in the page yet. Please add the installation code to the page source so it appears in the head of the page. We will confirm once it is in place.

We also found two items to review on your site:

1. The page takes about 10.4 seconds to load. Please review it and aim for under 6 seconds.
2. The donate page at https://donate.wck.org/campaign/749360/donate?c_src=site-navbar returned an access error (HTTP 403) to our check. Please confirm that visitors can open this page.

Once these changes are made, reply to this email and we will run the check again.

Thank you,
Onboarding Team
